responsibility: Adds 32-bit Linux/ELF ABI details on top of the generic PA Linux layer. It enables the ELF32 ABI flag, arranges CRT references needed for `__canonicalize_funcptr_for_compare`, provides PIC-safe static-constructor call glue for crtstuff, tweaks endfile linkage to pull in libgcc support, sets 32-bit Linux `wchar_t` and malloc alignment ABI rules, changes jump-table section placement for PIC versus non-PIC, and overrides RTX section selection for COMDAT function references.
